headline: Connect at ChemEquip 2026: Exclusive Invitation to Our E3-36 Booth
body:
Dear Industry Peers,
We cordially invite you to visit our Booth E3-36 at ChemEquip 2026 (Shanghai, November 18-21, 2026) to witness the global launch of our new X-series molecular sieve adsorbents.
Engineered with an optimized alumina-silica ratio for enhanced lattice stability, this product features extended service life and is tailored for two core application scenarios: energy efficiency optimization of air separation units and deep natural gas dehydration.
Calculated based on 8,000 operating hours per year, it delivers a significant reduction in regeneration energy consumption.
We look forward to connecting with you at the event.
